title: Lovable vs v0: Which AI App Builder Should You Choose in 2026?
summary: Lovable vs v0 compared: frontend generator vs component builder. Plus why most founders end up at Blink for full-stack apps. Honest 2026 comparison.
body_markdown: Lovable is genuinely good for non-technical founders building simple apps — it's the most accessible of the three. But the infrastructure gap catches most non-technical founders off guard: after Lovable generates your app, you still need to manage Supabase credentials, understand row-level security policies, and handle deployment yourself if you outgrow` lovable.app` hosting.[Blink](https://blink.new/) is designed so non-technical founders never hit that wall — the database is managed, auth is built in, and hosting is handled. The same prompt that gives you an MVP in Lovable gives you a production-ready app in Blink, with no second phase of infrastructure configuration.
